terms.gloss: duties, functions, especially official ones; in classical Latin only in the nominative and accusative
evidence: Liv. 1.42: bellī pācisque mūnia facere (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: sed fēmina ingēns animī mūnia ducis per eōs diēs induit
phrases.english: but a woman of great spirit took on a general’s duties in those days

sources: Lewis & Short: munia
